_comment: The scraper is NOT deployed to Vercel — it needs headed Chromium and persistent platform sessions (no serverless/free path). See DECISIONS.md. This config only fixes the previously-broken paths (which pointed at nonexistent capitalised src/Instagram.ts etc.) to the real per-platform route servers so the file matches the codebase. The public demo runs in replay mode from the frontend (scraper/src/replay/ and the /demo route).
